name: sleepmoore-site
description: The public website for the Sleep Moore app, built with Astro and served by GitHub Pages.

scripts.test: astro build && node test/check.mjs && node test/seo.mjs && html-validate dist/index.html dist/support/index.html dist/privacy/index.html dist/admin/index.html "dist/worlds/*/index.html" "dist/{sounds,stories,meditations,guides,compare}/**/index.html" dist/about/index.html dist/press/index.html
